items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: We all called him Swindell... I said, well, good thing I couldn't get to him first... he was a good alto player.

ctx.x: Oh, what was the name? Was it George? We all called him Swindell. His last name was (Unintelligible) Swindell, and his wife, when he got on that thing and he kind of went out of the picture, and then there was a group that came from California, and they wanted an alto player. He started straightening up then. And they'd taken him out to the West Coast. I said, well, good thing I couldn't get to him first, because stay out there because you'll make it out there. And he met this girl. She was going to college. And…
When they came back to New York, he died. I don't know whether it was pneumonia or what, TB or something like that, but he was a good alto player. Very fine alto player.
